\(225 - \left[ {42 - \left\{ {25 - \left( {18{\rm{\;}}-{\rm{\;}}\overline {18\; + \;13} } \right)} \right\}} \right]\)

⇒ 225 – [42 – (38)]

questions.question: The two given expressions on either side of the ‘=’ sign will have the same value if two terms on either side or on the same side are interchanged. Find from the given option the correct terms to be interchanged. 5 × 2 + 8 ÷ 2 – 1 = 9 – 6 ÷ 3 + 6 × 3
questions.questionHtml:
The two given expressions on either side of the ‘=’ sign will have the same value if two terms on either side or on the same side are interchanged. Find from the given option the correct terms to be interchanged. 

5 × 2 + 8 ÷ 2 – 1 = 9 – 6 ÷ 3 + 6 × 3
questions.solution:
By interchanging the given numbers and using BODMAS rule,

Option 1 → 1 and 9

5 × 2 + 8 ÷ 2 – 9 = 1 – 6 ÷ 3 + 6 × 3

5 × 2 + 4 – 9 = 1 – 2 + 6 × 3

10 + 4 – 9 = 1 – 2 + 18

14 – 9 = 19 – 2

5 ≠ 17

Option 2 → 5 and 9

9 × 2 + 8 ÷ 2 – 1 = 5 – 6 ÷ 3 + 6 × 3

9 × 2 + 4 – 1 = 5 – 2 + 6 × 3

18 + 4 – 1 = 5 – 2 + 18

22 – 1 = 23 – 2

21 = 21

Option 3 → 8 and 9

5 × 2 + 9 ÷ 2 – 1 = 8 – 6 ÷ 3 + 6 × 3

5 × 2 + 4.5 – 1 = 8 – 2 + 6 × 3

10 + 4.5 – 1 = 8 – 2 + 18

14.5 – 1 = 26 – 2

13.5 ≠ 24

Option 4→ 2 and 6

15 × 6 + 8 ÷ 6 – 1 = 9 – 2 ÷ 3 + 2 × 3

5 × 6 + 1.3 – 1 = 9 – 0.6 + 2 × 3

30 + 1.3 – 1 = 9 – 0.6 + 6

31.3 – 1 = 15 – 0.6

30.3 ≠ 14.4

Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.
